content.text: Stripe's blanket ban on several countries has left thousands of digital creators without a reliable way to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products. In Nigeria, for instance, creators are forced to rely on restrictive payment gateways or abandon online sales altogether. But help is here: COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks offer a free, sovereign solution to hosting and selling digital products, without the need for PayPal, Stripe, or any other platform.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a collection of free and paid tools that allow digital creators to host and sell their products independently, without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This architecture is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives creators full control over their online store and customer data. By using a sovereign stack, creators can avoid platform fees, maintain data ownership, and scale their business without restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack typically consists of GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account requirements. This architecture allows creators to sell their products directly to customers, without intermediaries or platform fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase. Both approaches work reliably and cost nothing beyond the storage used.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives creators full control over their online store and customer data.

By combining these components, creators can build a fully functional online store that operates independently.
